Collaboration & Distribution

HTML decks live in Git, ship as a URL, and weigh 10× less

  • Version control: every change is tracked in Git and reviewed line by line in a pull request
  • CI/CD pipelines: lint, test and deploy on every merge, with no manual export step
  • Reviewed before release: nothing reaches the audience until a teammate has approved the diff
